component.name: TASCAM UH-7000 Linux Support
component.summary: Unofficial UAC2 integration and feedback-safe control panel

description.p: Selects the UH-7000 USB Audio 2.0 configuration, registers it with the stock Linux snd_usb_audio driver, and provides a clean-room control panel. Playback tests are locked until software and DSP monitor loops are absent.
